params.topic: Veikkausliiga 2019-2025 row-level official round, fixture identity, venue, kickoff and timezone evidence
questions: Return row-level evidence for every 2019-2025 fixture, including official_round when an explicit round or matchday source exists, fixture identity, date, local kickoff, venue, city, venue coordinates and IANA timezone when explicitly evidenced.

Prioritize explicit round or matchday groupings from official Veikkausliiga or Palloliitto sources. Playmakerstats edition and team match pages may be used as a cross-check or fallback only when the page visibly labels Matchday/round; preserve the page URL, locator, retrieval time and SHA-256.
Never derive official_round from date order, CSV row order, scores, standings, odds, or team occurrence count. Preserve NULL/unavailable for rows without explicit round evidence.

For every row include competition_key, season, fixture_key, date, kickoff, kickoff_timezone, home_team, away_team, official_round, venue, city, venue_latitude, venue_longitude, venue_timezone, status, source_name, source_url, final_url, retrieved_at, field_locator, source_sha256, and evidence_notes.

Do not infer meeting_number, first/second meeting, double_round_robin, Qimen charts, palaces, relations, odds, probabilities, Outcome, Review, Gold, or model conclusions. meeting_number must remain NULL/unavailable unless an authoritative definition is explicitly found.

Return audit totals separately for each season and distinguish complete row-level evidence, partial rows, unavailable fields and unresolved rows. Do not include any 2026 fixture in the audit or unresolved queue.

known_local_scope.known_gap: 2019-2025 official_round remains unresolved for about 1131 fixtures; fixture identity and venue evidence are partial/secondary in prior rows

notes: This request narrows the active work to 2019-2025. It supersedes 2026 work for current prioritization without deleting or rewriting req-20261006-002 or req-20261006-003. Evidence-only supplement; do not write formal Snapshot/Outcome/Review/Gold or SQLite records.
